claims.claim_text: The indexed First Lieutenant James Angleton is strongly matched to the CIA biography's James Angleton, an Army officer recruited into OSS.
claims.evidence_excerpt: Angleton did not finish law school because he was drafted into the U.S. Army in March 1943.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The index supplies the exact distinctive name and First Lieutenant rank; the CIA supplies Army-to-OSS chronology and separately names his father James Hugh Angleton.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Exact distinctive indexed name plus matching commissioned Army and OSS context.
claims.temporal_assessment: The biography dates the draft to March 1943 and places OSS recruitment during Army training.
claims.match_notes: The adjacent James H. Angleton, Lieutenant Colonel, row is preserved separately and remains under manual review.

claims.claim_text: Angleton's immediate pre-OSS affiliation was U.S. Army training.
claims.evidence_excerpt: During training he was singled out for an interview and offered the chance to work with the Office of Strategic Services
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The CIA chronology explicitly places OSS recruitment during Army training after Angleton's March 1943 draft.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Strong identity match to the indexed First Lieutenant James Angleton.
claims.temporal_assessment: Explicit immediate sequence: Army draft and training, then OSS offer and acceptance.
claims.match_notes: Army service is modeled as a military assignment, not a civilian employer.

claims.claim_text: Angleton attended Harvard Law School from after his 1941 Yale graduation until his March 1943 Army draft.

claims.evidence_paraphrase: The CIA biography supplies the educational sequence and says the Army draft interrupted law school.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Strong identity match to the indexed James Angleton.
claims.temporal_assessment: Explicitly pre-OSS but separated from OSS by Army service.
claims.match_notes: Harvard is not classified as an employer.

claims.claim_text: Angleton studied at Yale and graduated in 1941.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The biography documents Yale attendance and literary-magazine work before Harvard and Army service.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Strong identity match to the indexed James Angleton.
claims.temporal_assessment: Documented prewar education, not the immediate predecessor to OSS.
claims.match_notes: Yale is not classified as an employer.
